As the battle distance continues to grow with each new weapon, humans put their best minds to work refining and evolving their designs over the millennia to gain the upper hand.

Groundbreaking developments lead to a technologically sophisticated society; the first data-recording device from over 5,000 years ago; how weaving creates binary code; electric cars are invented 100 years earlier than originally imagined.

Throughout history, ancestors have always strived to go higher, bigger, deeper, further.

title: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet
description:
E3
A miraculous mantle envelops the entire planet - a thin skin of gasses called 'air'. Without it, there would be no life or weather, no habitable conditions, or protection from lethal ultraviolet radiation or meteorites from outer space.

title: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet
description:
E1
It's the solid crust of our planet, the perfect element in which to record the stories of deep time and of lifetimes. Change and progression is the way of earth. Air and water turn solid rock into soil.

title: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet
description:
E2
How the flow of water has the power to shape all inhabitants on Earth, produces climate-changing weather and supporting species, from the largest whales to microscopic plankton.

title: Wild Kingdoms
description:
E1
Arid and unforgiving, deserts push their inhabitants to the extreme; from the desert elephant to the shovel-snouted lizard, see how they survive.

title: Wild Kingdoms
description:
E2
Rivers are the life veins of this planet, offering all those that depend on them respite from both heat and thirst; a look into how for the life they give, they also take away.

title: Wild Kingdoms
description:
E3
Africa's rainforests are second only to the Amazon in size; see these tangled worlds, that are home to chimpanzees, gorillas and forest elephants, one of the last remaining strongholds for the planet's wild creatures.

title: What's My Car Worth?
description:
E1
Keith and Josh attend a Barrett-Jackson event in Scottsdale, Ariz., where they find a beautifully restored Chevrolet Chevelle SS LS5 and test out a Porsche 930 Turbo; Keith gets behind the wheel of a Ferrari 365 GTB/4 Daytona.

title: What's My Car Worth?
description:
E2
Keith Martin and Josh Nasar encounter plenty of muscle at a Barrett-Jackson collector car auction in Scottsdale, Ariz., including a Pontiac GTO Judge and a 1987 Buick GNX.

title: What's My Car Worth?
description:
E3
A Yenko goes up for sale in Scottsdale, Ariz.; an eye-popping Lamborghini Gallardo is found at an Auctions America event in Florida.

title: What's My Car Worth?
description:
E4
Keith tests the power of fuel injection in a 1965 Chevrolet Corvette, while Josh takes a spin in a 1996 Porsche 911 Turbo; RM Auctions in Arizona offers up a Ferrari 512 TR.

title: What's My Car Worth?
description:
E5
An elegant, short-nosed Ferrari 275 GTB hits the auction block in Arizona and hammers at an impressive number.

title: What's My Car Worth?
description:
E6
An Oldsmobile 4-4-2 with a highly sought-after W30 option; a legendary Shelby 289 Cobra with sentimental value hits the auction block.

title: What's My Car Worth?
description:
E7
Keith and Josh reflect on classic vehicles from 1991, including a Ferrari Testarossa and an Alfa Romeo Spider.

title: What's My Car Worth?
description:
E8
Keith Martin and Josh Nasar attend a Barrett-Jackson auction event in Scottsdale, Ariz., where they drive a low-mileage Ferrari 512 TR and a survivor 1967 Corvette.

title: What's My Car Worth?
description:
E9
Josh takes a spin in a 2005 Ford GT, a sports car inspired by the 1960s GT40 that achieved success at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

title: What's My Car Worth?
description:
E10
A rare Lamborghini Miura SV, one of only five single-sump SVs sold new to the United States, hits the auction block in Arizona.

title: What's My Car Worth?
description:
E11
Keith cruises in a restored Alfa Romeo Giulietta Spider Veloce; Josh drives a 1997 Porsche Turbo S, which was the last 911 Turbo manufactured with an air-cooled engine.

title: What's My Car Worth?
description:
E12
Vehicles at a Barrett-Jackson event in Scottsdale, Ariz., include a 1967 Shelby GT500 Fastback and a 1970 Plymouth 'Cuda with an original 440 Six-Pack.
